evidence_weights.math: Bull 85 + bear 0 + neutral 15 = 100 points. Conflict = min(85, 0) = 0. CALL = 85 − 0 = 85%; PUT = 0 − 0 = 0%; WAIT = 15 + 2 × 0 = 15%.
